versions.changelog:
Version 8.1.1

- Removed 24 compiled Python cache files and test cache files to reduce package size and improve clarity.
- Updated version metadata and documentation (CHANGELOG.md, README.md, SKILL.md, VERSION.txt) to reflect latest capabilities and usage guidelines.
- No core logic changes to scripts or functionality.
- Filesystem cleanup for improved maintainability, performance, and platform compatibility.

**V8.1.0 brings rigorous interactive controls testing for p5.js educational content.**

- Added mandatory integrity checks for all p5.js interactive controls (button, slider, select, input, canvas, key, touch, drag) with 27 pass/fail criteria.
- New test suite (`tests/test_p5js_interactive.py`) ensures each interactive element is present, responsive, and error-free.
- Existing button-only validation from V8 retained and backward-compatible.
- Upgraded documentation and registry requirements for interactive components in generated HTML.
- Continues full edge-cloud transparency, privacy, and cost monitoring features from previous versions.
